candidate.title: scTrio-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina scTrio-Seq row at schematic scope, from its own title and Single-cell triple omics sequencing (scTrio-seq) caption through cell isolation, RNA/nucleus separation, RNA-to-cDNA preparation, the two drawn DNA routes, PCR/sequencing and alignment. The upper sci-CAR graphics and separately titled lower scTrio-Seq2 row are neighbouring catalogue context, with independent starting routes and no alternative connector to this row; neither is a target. Left-hand polyA RNA, DNA and DNA methylation icons describe the measured modalities, rather than an additional preparative split. The graph preserves the direct adapter-added DNA track as drawn. Hou et al. resolve the experimental methylation and CNV carrier as the same RRBS dataset, represented by a separately identified paper-supported readout interface. scRRBS is a component of scTrio-Seq, not another target method. No complete laboratory recipe or identity with other methods is asserted.
